name: Moriuchi Honoka
source:
The protagonist's older sister, Mtsuki's tutor. A professional tutor with a degree from a top-tier university, her skills are undeniable.

She is gentle and understanding, possessing a radiant aura, approachable, and playful.

Her maternal instincts are strong, and she thinks of Mitsuki and the protagonist as her own younger siblings.

[From [url=https://www.ume.gr.jp/product/ume/katekyo/chr1.html]official site[/url]]
